metadata.title: Single-mechanism ablation
metadata.claim_boundary: mechanism necessity observations for G3 only; excluded from B1/B2/G3 primary ranking

research_question: Which authorization, atomicity, commitment, uniqueness, or audit failures are actually observed when exactly one CRS protection is removed from G3?

variants.removed_mechanism: Runtime recomputation and equality check of canonical commitment
variants.target_scenario: tamper committed price or buyer while retaining the market-supplied commitment
variants.secure_oracle: reject before settlement; false_accept=true if the tampered request changes business state or settles

variants.target_scenario: a registered and operation-capable market without object-level authorization requests TransferRight
variants.secure_oracle: reject AuthorizationMissing; false_accept=true if a protected order is created, funded, or settled

variants.removed_mechanism: order terminal-state and unique SettlementRecord guard
variants.target_scenario: two settle attempts target the same Funded TransferMeta order
variants.secure_oracle: at most one success and exactly one SettlementRecord; duplicate_success=true for any second success

variants.removed_mechanism: atomic issuance quota reservation at funding
variants.target_scenario: two IssueRight orders compete for the last available authorization quota
variants.secure_oracle: at most one funded-and-settled issuance and issued + reserved <= max; duplicate_success=true if both issue

variants.removed_mechanism: SettlementRecord creation inside the atomic settlement transition
variants.target_scenario: complete the state transition and intentionally withhold the separated record-finalization call
variants.secure_oracle: a Settled order and changed ownership/right state require exactly one matching SettlementRecord; audit_gap=true when closure is absent or mismatched

controls.reference_commit: the approved clean G3 candidate selected at preflight
controls.fixture_roles_prices_fees_timing_and_see: frozen and identical across reference and variant
controls.checker_oracle: derived from unablated shared protocol v1, not from expected ablation behavior
controls.ranking_policy: never aggregate with or rank B1, B2, and G3

variant_identity.diff_allowlist: only the named protection and the minimum test wiring needed to expose it
variant_identity.result_reporting: report only checker-derived observed violations; an expected violation that is not observed remains a valid zero observation

expected_result_rules: The secure oracle remains the unablated shared protocol v1 expectation for every trial.
false_accept, duplicate_success, dirty_state, and audit_gap are computed from actual authoritative pre/post state, records, and events.
No violation is inserted because it was anticipated; only observed checker output is reportable.
Ablation results remain auxiliary-ablation evidence and cannot enter the primary architecture cost or correctness ranking.
stop_gates: variant commit is dirty, unidentified, reused, or has not passed E0
the diff removes or changes more than one named protection
fixture, request sequence, secure oracle, checker, or schema changes after preflight
actual authoritative state, record, or event evidence is incomplete
checker cannot distinguish a protocol violation from harness failure
result is labeled as primary evidence or included in B1/B2/G3 ranking
